samples.identity: Session continuity and local SQLite memory MCP server for coding agents
evidence: package.json postinstall reaches dist/hooks/install.js install; installer registers local npm hook commands and npx MCP configuration.
Hooks read host-provided transcript paths and save summaries, hot files and task state in .claude/sessions.db.
Verification tools run project build/test commands through local stdio MCP requests. No network-facing task listener.
Embedding utilities load Xenova/multilingual-e5-small for local feature extraction. Model acquisition is expected library behavior; no source-to-send theft chain.
Core features are enabled by default, contrary to the manifest claim that every feature is opt-in.
All 85 members are regular source, declarations, manifest, license or README files; no path traversal or symlinks.
samples.summary: passbaton 2.2.0: MCP config writes are capability, not compromise

samples.identity: Bundled knowledge-base skill and documentation validator for coding agents
evidence: Postinstall detects agent clients, copies the bundled skill tree, and registers a Python orientation hook for Claude sessions.
Global hook removal is remembered by a marker; preuninstall removes attributable hooks and installed skills.
Orient reads bounded, confined project documentation and prints context; its call graph contains no subprocess or eval.
Optional gate parses hook JSON and checks protected project paths; Git subprocesses inspect revision and staleness state.
Knowledge tools hash source bytes, validate claim provenance, generate indexes and copy confined portability bundles. No outbound networking or credential-harvesting code.
All 29 members are regular scripts, skill documentation, manifests, licenses or notices.
